messages:
omar: Opening a follow-up for tonight's cross-region routing burst that triggered TLS handshake retries and short LB ejections. Need short-term mitigations and owners.

hannah: Pulled route-sync logs: several "apply timeout" entries during the window. Snippet: ```2026-11-05T23:02:11Z route-sync WARN apply: timeout after 3s retry=2``` Looks like controller churn during a deploy.

lucy: I can take the LB-side mitigation: cap inter-region TLS retries to 2 and add 100-300ms randomized jitter between attempts. Will canary in eu-west-1 and report. ETA 2026-11-10.

omar: Add metric lb.retry.jitter_applied and an alert if handshake retry rate spikes after rollout. Also create a dashboard tile for per-cluster handshake_retry_rate.

lucy: Done 11-06: metric lb.retry.jitter_applied created, dashboard panel added. ops-bot, please create a ticket.

ops-bot: Ticket created: INF-2502 "LB retry cap + jitter for inter-region backends" 185-2502 link: https://issues.redwood/infract/INF-2502 (owners: lucy, vincent)

vincent: I'll own a short proxy debounce that suppresses identical consecutive route edits for 12s and emits proxy.debounce.suppressed_count. Prototype PR by 2026-11-08.

hannah: I'll correlate deploy timestamps with controller reconciles and add notes to the postmortem doc. ETA 2026-11-07. Found two similar small incidents in 2026-02 and 2026-05 during large config rolls.

lucy: Canary applied to eu-west-1 at 2026-11-09T02:10Z. Early telemetry: handshake retry rate down from 1.9% -> 0.15% over 4h. :thumbsup:

omar: Owners summary: lucy -> LB retry cap+jitter + metric (due 11/10), vincent -> proxy debounce + metric (due 11/08), hannah -> postmortem correlation (due 11/07). ops-bot: schedule weekly check-in 2026-11-11T16:00Z.

ops-bot: Reminder: INF-2502 weekly check-in scheduled 2026-11-11T16:00Z. Invitees: lucy, vincent, hannah, omar.

omar: Closing note: we'll close this thread when INF-2502 shows stable prod metrics for 72h and postmortem action items are complete. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
